description: Create a short-lived (2 h) link that opens the wholesaler's shop in the person's browser, logged in via IDS-Connect/OCI. The basket the person builds there comes back automatically (list_wholesale_carts) and is tied to project_ref (e.g. the clockin project id/number). Credentials are never in the link. IDS actions: WKE (open shop, return basket — default), ADL (article detail, needs article_no), WKS (send a stored basket to the shop to order it, needs cart_id), LI, SV. Hand the link to the person (chat, mail); do not open it yourself.

action.description: IDS-Aktion WKE (Vorgabe), ADL, WKS, LI, SV

shop.description: Großhändler: provider (grosshandel_…), Kurzname oder Name aus list_wholesale_shops
